pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, confident dark outlines, solid uniform fill colors. No gradients, shading, perspective rendering effects or texture. The second-person pronoun 'YOU' expressed WITHOUT WORDS. A single friendly person looks DIRECTLY at the viewer and points a relaxed index finger directly toward THE VIEWER, arm extended forward at chest level. The foreshortened hand clearly addresses the person looking at the picture. Warm neutral expression, not accusing, other hand relaxed. Anatomically believable hand and arm. Complete figure with plain unmarked shoes. No speech balloons or symbols. A friendly young man in an orange top clearly pointing forward at the viewer, with one index finger extended and other fingers curled. Entire standing figure. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background, show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. IMPORTANT: zoom the composition OUT. Leave roughly ONE SIXTH of canvas width on both the left and right and generous WHITE space above and below. No object or person's extremity touches an edge. No border. Absolutely no text, lettering, digits, writing or pseudo-writing, labels, watermarks, brand marks, logos or emblems anywhere. One clear composition.
